program.name: Hips & Hamstrings Yoga
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Yoga for the tightest places: a long hip-opening flow one day, hamstrings the next.
program.about: Yoga for the two tightest places in most bodies. One day opens the hips: pigeon, lizard, frog and garland. The other the hamstrings: forward folds, half splits and pyramid-style stretches. Each starts with sun salutations and ends with rest. Both later levels make every hold longer.
